name: Laras salendro (satu set terdokumentasi)
description: Pentatonis dengan lima langkah yang nyaris sama rata. Salendro TIDAK punya standar baku — setiap perangkat berbeda. Angka di sini adalah satu set yang terdokumentasi, bukan 'salendro yang benar', dan boleh Anda ubah.
descriptionEn: Near-equidistant pentatonic. Salendro has no fixed standard and varies between sets. These cents are one documented interval set, editable, and are not presented as the tuning.

source.title: Jaap Kunst, Music in Java (Martinus Nijhoff, 1949) — slendro described as an approximately equidistant five-tone division of the octave
source.note: Idealised near-equidistant reading: 1200/5 = 240 cents per step. Measured Sundanese sets deviate from this by tens of cents in either direction; treat as a reference point, not an authority.
